subject: Trading
title: Peter Lynch: Invest in What You Know
description: Learn Peter Lynch: Invest in What You Know in one minute.

hook.text: Peter Lynch averaged 29% annual returns for 13 years at Fidelity Magellan—the best mutual fund track record ever.

buildup.text: Lynch believed ordinary people could find great stocks by observing products and companies they encounter daily.

discovery.text: He categorized stocks: fast growers, stalwarts, turnarounds, cyclicals. Each type required a different strategy.

twist.text: Despite his advice to individuals, Lynch held over 1,000 stocks simultaneously. His diversification was extreme.

climax.text: Lynch retired at 46, saying the job consumed his life. Even the greatest returns come with personal costs.

punchline.text: He found winners in shopping malls, not spreadsheets.

quiz.question: What was Peter Lynch's core investing philosophy?
options: Invest in companies and products you understand from daily life
